answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with larger rewards unlocked only by sustained, verifiable honest work. Trust is a dune built slowly: a new identity starts low, with small rewards, and only a long record of checkable service builds it higher. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund every stake separately and do real work for each, so cost scales with each fake while profit per fake stays capped. Like sable fur that cannot be faked cheaply, or a lagoon kept clear by filtering inflow, reputation must be earned gradually, not minted at will.
